name: monkeymode
description: MonkeyMode: I'm Monkey Game Developer. A game-dev plugin set for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: mm-core
plugins.description: Engine-agnostic MonkeyMode: the design-to-ship game dev workflow (brief, GDD, narrative, UX, architecture, epics, stories, dev, review, playtest, retrospective), agent operating docs, guardrails with an after-edit hook, and the mm-setup onboarding.

plugins.name: mm-unity
plugins.description: Unity adapter for MonkeyMode: C# banned APIs, assembly direction rules, batch-mode test/build scripts, Mirror and NGO multiplayer notes, asset import checklist, and the mm-unity-expert subagent.

plugins.name: mm-godot
plugins.description: Godot 4 adapter for MonkeyMode: GDScript node path and signal rules, headless test commands, high-level multiplayer notes, and the mm-godot-expert subagent. Checked against the Godot 4.7 docs.

plugins.name: mm-unreal
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5 adapter for MonkeyMode: UObject/GC rules, banned C++ patterns, UBT/automation test commands, replication notes, and the mm-unreal-expert subagent. Partly checked against the Unreal Engine 5.9 docs.

plugins.name: mm-bevy
plugins.description: Bevy adapter for MonkeyMode: no blocking in systems, system ordering, Clippy bans, cargo test commands, lightyear/replicon/renet notes, and the mm-bevy-expert subagent. Checked against Bevy 0.20.

plugins.name: mm-agents
plugins.description: Optional MonkeyMode pack: 16 Claude Code subagents (game, level, UI/UX, narrative, audio and economy design; gameplay, network, performance, technical art, QA, localization, build and release; read-only code review and guardrail audit; docs), plus persona skills (game designer, architect, developer, solo dev, tech writer, analyst, PM, UX designer) and party mode.

plugins.name: mm-art-tools
plugins.description: Optional MonkeyMode pack: concept art (ChatGPT prompts, Codex CLI or alternatives) and CLI harnesses for Blender, RenderDoc and Nsight Graphics.
